title: Kerala School Sasthrolsavam Manual 2025
notes: 250-page PDF downloaded. Relevant general, appeal, championship, science and IT pages visually inspected. Printed body page plus 11 generally locates the PDF page. The foreword on PDF page 3 says the manual was prepared in 2009 and revised in 2019. LP scoring on printed page 64 contains component/total inconsistencies. HS Working Model on printed pages 40–41 stipulates two pupils; note 3 on page 44 requires group participation counts.

title: 2026 official Sasthrolsavam download zone
notes: Opened. The current zone links the 2025 manual and a school-login guide with a 2022–23 filename. File dates and portal edition dates remain distinct.

title: Official 2025 state item catalogue
notes: Opened the science rows. Codes and participant capacities are factual catalogue data, not independent proof of eligibility at the state level.

title: IT Mela 2026 school subdistrict and revenue district instructions
notes: KITE/2026/1275(8). Single scanned page downloaded and visually read. Mandates KITE Ubuntu 22.04; updates typing, animation, presentation, webpage design and Scratch. No Working Model item is added.

title: KITE circular index
notes: Opened. The 3 September 2026 entry links the official 1136.pdf circular.

title: Kerala 2026–27 science theme adoption circular
notes: Y1/9214/2026/DGE, three PDF pages. Downloaded; NCERT attachment on PDF page 3 visually inspected. Its main title differs from the explanatory note’s description of the main theme; the discrepancy is retained.

title: Electronics IoT Robotics and science magazine instructions 2026
notes: Y1/8659/2026/DGE, four PDF pages. Downloaded, text extracted, first three pages visually inspected. Explicit three-hour conditions apply to the named on-the-spot digital events, not automatically to Science Working Model or IT events.

title: Kerala Science Drama 2026 circular and VITM annexures
notes: Y1/13334/2026/DGE, nine PDF pages. Downloaded and text extracted. Kerala state event scheduled for 11 November 2026 at Thrissur; regional event for 19–20 November 2026 at VITM. First-only advancement within Kerala differs from the regional invitation to first and second prize winners. Drama scoring matched the 2025 manual.

title: 2025–26 examination grace mark circular
notes: Y1/23504/2025/DGE; cites G.O.(Ms)65/2026/GEDN dated 12 March 2026. Six PDF pages downloaded; grace tables on pages 1–3 visually inspected. Applies to 2025–26 examinations; do not project it to 2026–27.

title: School Sasthrolsavam software school login guide
notes: Five-page official guide linked from the 2026 download zone. Opened and text read. It establishes an older documented registration workflow rather than proving every current screen is identical.
version_evidence: Filename and screenshots identify2022–23; linked by2026portal.

title: Official 2026 state item catalogue
notes: Current catalogue inspected in shared research collection. HS Science Working Model is item 115, group capacity two. The IT catalogue lists standard student and teacher events without a Working Model item. Generic catalogue entries do not independently determine eligibility at the state level.
